The remaining exactly 58 odd squarefree 3≤m≤143 are exhausted by an independently recomputed orbit test: for each p|m, x1=2^8 mod p and x_{r+1}=x_r^8 mod p; if -m/p mod p is absent from the finite orbit, no r works. Fresh code confirmed a blocking prime for every candidate, 33 different blockers and maximal orbit length52. The invariant 2^8≡111 mod145 and 111^8≡111 mod145 yields μ_r≡111 mod145, and 29+111 divisible by5 and 5+111 divisible by29, so 145 satisfies all r. The finite m-bound is complete, while the orbit recurrence proves uniformity over infinitely many r.
